title: A COMPASS to the Galaxy: Joint nucleosynthetic yield set comparison and parameter inference in Galactic chemical evolution
abstract: arXiv:2611.21175v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Galactic Chemical Evolution (GCE) models connect stellar nucleosynthesis to observed abundance patterns, but their interpretation requires simultaneous parameter inference and comparison between competing stellar yield prescriptions. This remains challenging due to intractable likelihoods and growing dataset complexity. Using compass, a novel simulation-based inference framework, we perform, for the first time, amortized joint Bayesian model comparison and parameter inference for GCE models with intractable likelihoods within a unified architecture. Compass employs a conditional score-based diffusion model with a transformer architecture to learn both the posterior and likelihood directly from forward simulations, enabling efficient inference and likelihood-based ranking of competing nucleosynthetic yield sets. In controlled tests, compass identifies the generating yield set and recovers ground-truth parameters with accuracy comparable

translated_title: 银河系之指南针（COMPASS）：银河化学演化中核合成产额集合的联合比较与参数推断
translated_abstract: 银河化学演化（GCE）模型将恒星核合成与观测到的元素丰度模式联系起来，但对其结果的解读需要同时进行参数推断以及在相互竞争的恒星产额假说之间进行比较。由于似然函数难以解析处理，加之数据集复杂度不断增长，这一任务仍然充满挑战。利用compass这一新颖的基于模拟的推断框架，我们首次在统一的架构中，对具有难解似然函数的GCE模型实现了摊销式联合贝叶斯模型比较与参数推断。Compass采用结合transformer架构的条件分数扩散模型，直接从前向模拟中学习后验分布与似然函数，从而实现高效推断，并能基于似然对相互竞争的核合成产额集合进行排序。在受控测试中，compass能够识别出生成数据的产额集合，并以相当的精度恢复出真实参数。
tldr: 该论文提出compass框架，首次借助结合transformer架构的条件分数扩散模型，对具有难解似然的银河化学演化模型实现了摊销式联合贝叶斯模型比较与参数推断。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces COMPASS, a novel simulation-based inference framework that, for the first time, enables amortized joint Bayesian model comparison and parameter inference for Galactic chemical evolution models with intractable likelihoods, using a conditional score-based diffusion model with a transformer architecture.
